apps.name: Séance
apps.maturityNote: Estimated: SSH and sync workflows are implemented; mobile distribution and platform integration still have rough edges.
apps.summary: An SSH client with terminal sessions, a file browser and optional encrypted sync.

apps.name: Poltergeist
apps.maturityNote: Estimated: core transfers and editing are implemented; Android and extra-window limitations remain.
apps.summary: A two-pane SFTP client for browsing, transferring and synchronizing files.

apps.name: Planchette
apps.maturityNote: Estimated: core editing and guarded saves are implemented; distribution and large-file support are still limited.
apps.summary: A focused text editor and the editor foundation for Séance and Poltergeist.
